title: Measurement Source Type
description: Collection mechanism a count is built from — what was observed and how, not *who* observed it (the party is carried by a BrandRef: `billing_measurement.vendor`, `vendor_metric_values[].vendor`, `vendor_relationship`), not how an outcome was attributed (`attribution_methodology`), and not the maturation or IVT stage (`measurement_window`). Neutral vocabulary, not a quality ranking: the same value from two vendors is not thereby comparable. One vocabulary serves two surfaces: discovery-time `measurement_terms.billing_measurement.counting_sources[]` (what the billing count is counted from) and report-time `vendor_metric_values[].measurement_provenance.source_types[]` (what a reported vendor value was built from). Scoped to video, CTV, audio, and broadcast-style counting; sensor-based place measurement (camera, Wi-Fi, beam) has no value yet and is an additive minor when an adopter needs it. Broadcast as-run logs and station affidavits are airing evidence (proof that a spot ran), not a counting source for audience measurement, so they are not values here; delivery reports carry as-run data in `by_spot[]`, separately from audience rows. Ownership-flavored labels are deliberately not values: an ad server's logs and a publisher's logs are both `server_logs`; whether the log owner is the seller or an independent vendor is the BrandRef's job. Values cannot be renamed or removed once released; new values are additive (minor).

enumDescriptions.set_top_box: Set-top-box return-path data — tuning events from cable, satellite, or IPTV devices.
enumDescriptions.acr: Automatic content recognition — audio/video fingerprint matching from smart TVs or companion devices.
enumDescriptions.panel: Recruited respondent panel (meter- or diary-based) projected to a population.
enumDescriptions.server_logs: Events observed server-side in the decision or delivery path: ad-server, SSAI stitcher, or publisher/player-backend logs, including tracking URLs fired by a server on the player's behalf. Not a render confirmation. Log ownership is carried by the BrandRef, not by this value.
enumDescriptions.client_tracker: Declarative tracking URLs (pixels, beacons, VAST/DAAST tracking URLs) requested by the player or browser itself; no measurement code executes. Server-fired URLs are `server_logs`; executing code is `sdk`.
enumDescriptions.sdk: Measurement code executing in the player, app, or page — OM SDK verification, vendor JavaScript tags, mobile and CTV measurement SDKs.
